context.p: Application creation is a multi-step process, starting with naming the app and ending with the creation of your end-user menus. The steps are:

step.cmd: Select Objects to use in the app.
Create a Display and Save Maps.
Create Query, Display, and Save actions.

postreq.p: The steps are described in detail in the following sections. You will complete each step as you build your Opportunity Forecast app.
postreq.note: Prequisites You must connect (through the X-Author Designer) to an environment instance that is enabled for X-Author for Excel.
